description: Schema for the annotated speaking-turn dataset produced by the Gemini annotation pipeline. Each row represents one unique assistant speaking turn from the analyzed Claude Code session.

message_id.description: Row index (0-based). Not a real message ID — positional index in the speaking-turn sequence.

content.description: Text of the assistant speaking turn, truncated to 2,000 characters.

prior_tool_result.description: Most recent tool output before this message, truncated to 2,000 characters.

prior_assistant_content.description: Preceding assistant speaking turn text, truncated to 2,000 characters.

had_thinking.description: Whether the assistant message had a sibling thinking block in the same message.id group in the JSONL.

confidence.description: Annotator confidence score (0.0–1.0). Mean across dataset: 0.95.

evidence_present.description: Whether the annotator identified evidence in the prior tool result supporting the claim.

evidence_source.description: Free-text description of where the evidence came from, if present.

reasoning.description: Annotator's chain-of-thought justification for the assigned label.

labels.GROUNDED: Claim or summary directly traceable to prior tool output in context.
labels.INFERRED: Interpretation or reasoning from evidence, going beyond what tool output directly states.
labels.ASSERTED: Claim presented as fact with no grounding in prior tool output.
labels.CORRECTING: Explicit revision of a prior claim — acknowledges and reverses a previous statement.
labels.ACTION: Message announcing an upcoming tool call, with minimal independent claim content.
labels.MIXED: Message containing substantive content from two or more categories.

validation.determinism: 100% — same message annotated 3x produced identical labels in all 20 sampled messages
